text:
amy.support: FYI customer reported a tool-invoke failure when calling billing/update. They see a schema validation error and the request is rejected. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/18921 :eyes:

support-bot: New ticket #18921 created by customer  → priority: high, env: private-deploy

kevin.eng: Can you paste the failing payload + response? Want to see exact validator message.

amy.support: Pasting sanitized payload + response (customer removed PII):
```json
{
  "customer_id": "acct_123",
  "order_id": 987654,   // <-- should be string per schema
  "items": [{ "sku": "widget-a", "qty": 1 }],
  "billing_profile": {
    // missing required "id"
    "email": "user@example.com"
  },
  "debug_mode": true,    // <-- extra prop the schema disallows
  "meta": { "source": "checkout-v2" }
}
```
API response (400):
```json
{
  "error": "request_validation_failed",
  "details": [
    { "path": "/order_id", "message": "expected string, got number" },
    { "path": "/billing_profile/id", "message": "required property missing" },
    { "path": "", "message": "additionalProperties not allowed: debug_mode" }
  ]
}
```

kevin.eng: Thanks. Two obvious problems: order_id typing and missing billing_profile.id. The additionalProperties error is interesting — we don't usually block debug flags at the top level. What SDK/stack are they using?

amy.support: They said using redwood-js v0.8.1 + private deployment (region: eu-west-1). Customer says this started after a client rollout that added debug_mode. They also reported intermittent 500s at ~14:00 UTC.

mike.sre: Checked infra traces around 2025-09-30T14:02Z — validator-service latency spiked to ~800ms and retried twice, which correlates with the customer 500s. Snippet from logs:
```
[14:02:12] validator-service WARN validation_failed path="/billing/update" details="additionalProperties: debug_mode"
[14:02:12] validator-service ERROR upstream_timeout after 750ms
[14:02:13] request-router INFO retrying (attempt=2) cost=0.02s
```
Looks like the validator is strict and then times out when extra props hit a code path that calls an external lookup for billing_profile.id.

charlie.eng: Two options: 1) patch validator schema to allow unknown top-level keys (additionalProperties: true) and coerce/ignore debug_mode, or 2) make SDK/client strip unknown keys before send and improve ergonomic error message. Both okay but need risk/rollback plan.

kevin.eng: Prefer defensive server-side tolerance for now to stop customer outages. Patch idea: allow additionalProperties at root but keep required enforcement for billing_profile.id and order_id type coercion. Quick fix PR to validator-service + canary to 10% on dedicated infra. If canary looks good, roll to 100%.

amy.support: Customer asked for ETA. Can we do canary today?

kevin.eng: I'll open a PR and coordinate canary. Steps:
- PR to validator-service to set additionalProperties: true at root (kevin)
- Add telemetry to log stripped fields for 48h (charlie)
- Backfill a quick shim on SDK docs recommending coercion of order_id to string (amy)
- Run 10% canary for 1h, monitor 5xx rate & validation errors (mike)

mike.sre: I'll prepare the canary and watch latency/5xx and retry patterns. If upstream timeout > 500ms or 5xx > baseline+2% revert immediately.

amy.support: Great, I'll update the customer with the mitigation plan and ETA (2–3 hours). Thanks all :pray:

kevin.eng: One more note — we should add a consumer-facing error that includes guidance ("missing billing_profile.id" / "order_id must be string") instead of generic additionalProperties. Filed internal issue INF-8342.

amy.support: Adding to ticket, will keep you posted.
